# MappingExtensions native providers

These sources derive from the MIT-licensed maintained MappingExtensions implementation at signed commit 8813aa5. The original patch files remain in their repository and are excluded when the shared provider flag is enabled. Precision lanes/layers, authored wall encodings, negative/tiny wall repairs, mirroring integration and cut-direction behavior remain the preservation boundary. Native legacy signatures are selected in this provider. Fresh 1.29.1 and isolated 1.45.3/1.46.0 builds have zero warnings/errors. Read-only metadata matches 29 legacy and 34 newer hook contracts, with eight native IL matcher shapes. No transpilers or game methods were executed. Runtime compatibility remains unconfirmed.
